title: Read earthworks and estimated cost
description: Find the road’s cut and fill volumes and see how its base engineering estimate is itemised.

setup.goal: Read the earthwork volumes and the itemised base estimate.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000 with the cross-section shown.
limitations: Volumes and rates are illustrative and change when the road or the terrain changes.

overlay.title: Open Engineering
overlay.body: Open the Engineering tab, where the quantity and cost tools are.

check.description: the detail pane shows the quantities

overlay.title: Show the breakdown
overlay.body: Select Show quantities & cost breakdown. The detail pane switches to Engineering quantities.

overlay.title: Read the earthworks
overlay.body: In the road summary, Cut / fill gives excavation first and fill second: 5,086 m³ of cut and 22,158 m³ of fill. Complete sections, 100%, says how much of the road the volumes cover.

context.label: the quantities in the detail pane

overlay.title: Read the base estimate
overlay.body: In the cost table, excavation, fill placement, surfacing and clearing total $351,032.76 at the training rates. This is the base estimate: the road’s unpriced stream crossing still needs its own review.
